description: Manage devices, DNS, users, keys, policy files, logs, settings, and integrations in a Tailscale tailnet through the official REST API.

fields.label: OAuth Client ID
fields.description: Tailscale OAuth client ID created from the Trust credentials page in the Tailscale admin console.

fields.label: OAuth Client Secret
fields.description: Tailscale OAuth client secret paired with the client ID. Tailscale only shows this secret when the OAuth client is created.

fields.label: Tailnet ID
fields.description: Optional tailnet ID used in Tailscale API paths. Leave blank to use Tailscale's '-' shorthand for the OAuth client's tailnet.

actions.name: approve_user
actions.description: Approve a pending Tailscale user for the tailnet.

actions.name: batch_update_device_posture_attributes
actions.description: Set or remove custom posture attributes across multiple Tailscale devices.

nodes.description: Device IDs mapped to custom: attribute keys and their {value, expiry} updates. JSON Merge Patch semantics: a null attribute deletes it.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale batch posture attribute update input.

anyOf.description: Tailscale batch posture attribute update response.

outputSchema.description: Tailscale batch posture attribute update response.

actions.name: create_key
actions.description: Create an auth key, OAuth client credential, or federated trust credential and return its secret.

key.description: The key type, capabilities, expiry, scopes, tags, and identity configuration.

outputSchema.description: The created key metadata and one-time secret material.

actions.name: create_oauth_app
actions.description: Create a Tailscale OAuth application and return its client secret.

app.description: The OAuth app name, redirect URIs, scopes, and allowed node attributes.

outputSchema.description: The created OAuth app and one-time client secret.

actions.name: create_posture_integration
actions.description: Create a device posture integration using its external provider credentials.

integration.description: The posture provider, tenant configuration, and client credentials.

actions.name: create_webhook
actions.description: Create a webhook endpoint and return its signing secret.

webhook.description: The endpoint URL, provider type, and event subscriptions.

outputSchema.description: The created webhook and one-time signing secret.

actions.name: delete_device
actions.description: Permanently delete a device from its Tailscale tailnet.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device to delete.

actions.name: delete_device_invite
actions.description: Delete a Tailscale device share invite.

deviceInviteId.description: The Tailscale device invite ID to delete.

actions.name: delete_device_posture_attribute
actions.description: Permanently remove one custom posture attribute from a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

attributeKey.description: The custom posture attribute key to delete.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale delete device posture attribute input.

actions.name: delete_key
actions.description: Permanently revoke and delete a Tailscale trust credential or key.

keyId.description: The Tailscale key ID to revoke and delete.

actions.name: delete_oauth_app
actions.description: Permanently delete a Tailscale OAuth application and revoke its access.

appId.description: The Tailscale OAuth app ID to delete.

actions.name: delete_posture_integration
actions.description: Delete a device posture integration.

integrationId.description: The Tailscale posture integration ID to delete.

actions.name: delete_service
actions.description: Permanently delete a named Tailscale Service.

serviceName.description: The Tailscale Service name to delete.

actions.name: delete_user
actions.description: Permanently delete a Tailscale user from the tailnet.

userId.description: The Tailscale user ID to permanently delete.

actions.name: delete_webhook
actions.description: Permanently delete a Tailscale webhook endpoint.

endpointId.description: The webhook endpoint ID to delete.

actions.name: disable_log_streaming
actions.description: Disable and remove the destination configuration for a Tailscale log stream.

actions.name: expire_device_key
actions.description: Immediately expire a device key and require the device to authenticate again.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

actions.name: get_aws_external_id
actions.description: Create or retrieve the AWS external ID used by Tailscale log streaming.

reusable.description: Whether later reusable calls may receive this same external ID, until it is linked with an AWS account.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale get AWS external ID input.

outputSchema.description: The AWS external ID assigned to the tailnet.

actions.name: get_contacts
actions.description: Get the account, support, and security contacts for the tailnet.

outputSchema.description: The account, support, and security contacts.

actions.name: get_device
actions.description: Get one Tailscale device by its preferred node ID or legacy device ID.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

user.description: The user who registered the device.

hostname.description: The device hostname shown in the admin console.

addresses.description: Tailscale IPv4 and IPv6 addresses assigned to the device.

os.description: The operating system reported by the device.

created.description: When the device joined the tailnet.

connectedToControl.description: Whether the device recently connected to the Tailscale control server.

lastSeen.description: When the device last connected to the Tailscale control server.

authorized.description: Whether the device is authorized to join the tailnet.

isExternal.description: Whether the device is shared into the tailnet.

updateAvailable.description: Whether a newer Tailscale client is available.

keyExpiryDisabled.description: Whether key expiry is disabled for the device.

blocksIncomingConnections.description: Whether the device blocks incoming Tailscale connections.

enabledRoutes.description: Subnet routes enabled for the device.

advertisedRoutes.description: Subnet routes advertised by the device.

tags.description: ACL tags assigned to the device.

sshEnabled.description: Whether Tailscale SSH is enabled for the device.

outputSchema.description: A Tailscale device returned by the official API.

actions.name: get_device_invite
actions.description: Get one Tailscale device share invite.

actions.name: get_device_posture_attributes
actions.description: Get the posture attributes currently reported for a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

outputSchema.description: Posture attributes and expirations for the device.

actions.name: get_dns_configuration
actions.description: Get the complete DNS configuration for the tailnet.

actions.name: get_dns_preferences
actions.description: Get the tailnet DNS preferences, including MagicDNS state.

actions.name: get_key
actions.description: Get metadata for a Tailscale trust credential or key.

actions.name: get_log_streaming_configuration
actions.description: Get the potentially sensitive destination configuration for a Tailscale log stream.

outputSchema.description: The log streaming destination and credential configuration.

actions.name: get_log_streaming_status
actions.description: Get the current publishing status for configuration or network log streaming.

outputSchema.description: Log streaming activity, throughput, and failure statistics.

actions.name: get_oauth_app
actions.description: Get a Tailscale OAuth application by app ID.

actions.name: get_policy_file
actions.description: Get the current Tailscale policy file as JSON, optionally with validation details.

details.description: Whether to include the encoded policy, warnings, and errors.

policy.description: The current Tailscale policy file or detailed validation result.

anyOf.description: The policy version to pass as set_policy_file's ifMatch input.

etag.description: The policy version to pass as set_policy_file's ifMatch input.

outputSchema.description: The current Tailscale policy file and its version.

actions.name: get_posture_integration
actions.description: Get one device posture integration by ID.

actions.name: get_service
actions.description: Get a Tailscale Service by name.

actions.name: get_service_device_approval
actions.description: Get whether a Service is approved on a specific device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale get Service device approval input.

outputSchema.description: The Service approval state on the device.

actions.name: get_split_dns
actions.description: Get the split DNS nameserver mapping for the tailnet.

actions.name: get_tailnet_settings
actions.description: Get the tailnet feature, logging, networking, and policy settings visible to the OAuth client.

actions.name: get_user
actions.description: Get a Tailscale user by user ID.

actions.name: get_webhook
actions.description: Get a Tailscale webhook endpoint by ID.

actions.name: list_configuration_audit_logs
actions.description: List configuration audit logs for an RFC 3339 time window, with optional filters.

start.description: The start of the log window in RFC 3339 format.

end.description: The end of the log window in RFC 3339 format.

actors.description: Actor IDs or wildcard actor searches.

outputSchema.description: Configuration audit log entries and tailnet metadata.

actions.name: list_device_invites
actions.description: List all share invites for a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

outputSchema.description: The device share invites returned by Tailscale.

actions.name: list_device_routes
actions.description: List the subnet routes advertised and enabled for a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

outputSchema.description: Advertised and enabled routes for the device.

actions.name: list_devices
actions.description: List all devices in the configured Tailscale tailnet.

user.description: The user who registered the device.

hostname.description: The device hostname shown in the admin console.

addresses.description: Tailscale IPv4 and IPv6 addresses assigned to the device.

os.description: The operating system reported by the device.

created.description: When the device joined the tailnet.

connectedToControl.description: Whether the device recently connected to the Tailscale control server.

lastSeen.description: When the device last connected to the Tailscale control server.

authorized.description: Whether the device is authorized to join the tailnet.

isExternal.description: Whether the device is shared into the tailnet.

updateAvailable.description: Whether a newer Tailscale client is available.

keyExpiryDisabled.description: Whether key expiry is disabled for the device.

blocksIncomingConnections.description: Whether the device blocks incoming Tailscale connections.

enabledRoutes.description: Subnet routes enabled for the device.

advertisedRoutes.description: Subnet routes advertised by the device.

tags.description: ACL tags assigned to the device.

sshEnabled.description: Whether Tailscale SSH is enabled for the device.

items.description: A Tailscale device returned by the official API.

actions.name: list_dns_nameservers
actions.description: List the global DNS nameservers configured for the tailnet.

actions.name: list_dns_search_paths
actions.description: List the DNS search paths configured for the tailnet.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale list DNS search paths input.

actions.name: list_keys
actions.description: List trust credentials and keys visible to the OAuth client.

all.description: Whether to include expired and revoked keys.

outputSchema.description: The visible Tailscale trust credentials and keys.

actions.name: list_network_flow_logs
actions.description: List network flow logs for an RFC 3339 time window.

start.description: The start of the log window in RFC 3339 format.

end.description: The end of the log window in RFC 3339 format.

outputSchema.description: Network flow log entries and tailnet metadata.

actions.name: list_oauth_apps
actions.description: List OAuth applications configured for the tailnet.

outputSchema.description: The OAuth applications configured for the tailnet.

actions.name: list_posture_integrations
actions.description: List the device posture integrations configured for the tailnet.

actions.name: list_service_hosts
actions.description: List devices currently hosting a named Tailscale Service.

actions.name: list_services
actions.description: List the Services configured in the tailnet.

outputSchema.description: The Services configured in the tailnet.

actions.name: list_users
actions.description: List tailnet users with optional user-type and role filters.

type.description: User type filter. Defaults to all users, including users shared into the tailnet.

outputSchema.description: The users in the connected tailnet.

actions.name: list_webhooks
actions.description: List webhook endpoints configured for the tailnet.

outputSchema.description: The webhook endpoints configured for the tailnet.

actions.name: preview_policy_rule_matches
actions.description: Preview which rules in a proposed policy match a user or IP address and port without saving it.

previewFor.description: A user email or an IP address and port, depending on type.

policy.description: The proposed JSON policy document to evaluate.

users.description: Source entities affected by the rule.

lineNumber.description: The rule's location in the policy file.

matches.description: The proposed policy rules matching the requested resource.

type.description: Echoes the resource type provided in the request.

previewFor.description: Echoes the previewed user or IP address and port provided in the request.

outputSchema.description: The proposed policy rules matching the requested resource.

actions.name: resend_contact_verification_email
actions.description: Resend the verification email for a tailnet contact.

contactType.description: The contact category whose verification should be resent.

actions.name: restore_user
actions.description: Restore a suspended Tailscale user.

userId.description: The suspended Tailscale user ID to restore.

actions.name: rotate_webhook_secret
actions.description: Rotate a webhook signing secret and return the new secret once.

endpointId.description: The webhook endpoint ID whose secret should be rotated.

outputSchema.description: The rotated one-time webhook signing secret.

actions.name: set_device_authorized
actions.description: Authorize or deauthorize a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

authorized.description: Whether the device should be authorized.

actions.name: set_device_ip
actions.description: Set the Tailscale IPv4 address for a device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

actions.name: set_device_key_expiry
actions.description: Enable or disable key expiry for a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

keyExpiryDisabled.description: Whether device key expiry should be disabled.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale set device key expiry input.

anyOf.description: Tailscale set device key expiry response.

outputSchema.description: Tailscale set device key expiry response.

actions.name: set_device_name
actions.description: Set a Tailscale device name, or reset it from the OS hostname with an empty name.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

name.description: The new device name, or an empty string to reset it.

actions.name: set_device_posture_attribute
actions.description: Set one custom posture attribute on a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

attributeKey.description: A custom posture attribute key in the custom: namespace.

value.description: The attribute value. Tailscale accepts only a string, number, or boolean.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale set device posture attribute input.

outputSchema.description: The device's custom posture attributes after the update.

actions.name: set_device_routes
actions.description: Replace the enabled subnet routes for a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

routes.description: The complete list of subnet routes to enable.

outputSchema.description: The advertised and enabled routes after the update.

actions.name: set_device_tags
actions.description: Replace all ACL tags assigned to a Tailscale device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

tags.description: The complete replacement list of ACL tags.

actions.name: set_dns_configuration
actions.description: Replace the entire tailnet DNS configuration, including nameservers, split DNS, search paths, and preferences.

configuration.description: The complete replacement DNS configuration. This replaces rather than merges: any section left out is cleared, so send the full configuration.

actions.name: set_dns_nameservers
actions.description: Replace the global DNS nameservers configured for the tailnet.

dns.description: The complete replacement list of DNS nameserver addresses.

actions.name: set_dns_preferences
actions.description: Enable or disable MagicDNS for the tailnet.

actions.name: set_dns_search_paths
actions.description: Replace the DNS search paths configured for the tailnet.

searchPaths.description: The complete replacement list of DNS search domains.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale set DNS search paths input.

actions.name: set_log_streaming_configuration
actions.description: Create or replace a Tailscale log streaming destination configuration.

configuration.description: The complete destination configuration, including any required credentials.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale set log streaming configuration input.

anyOf.description: Tailscale set log streaming configuration response.

outputSchema.description: Tailscale set log streaming configuration response.

actions.name: set_policy_file
actions.description: Replace the Tailscale policy file after its embedded tests pass.

policy.description: The complete replacement Tailscale policy document.

ifMatch.description: The etag returned by get_policy_file. Rejects the write with HTTP 412 if the policy changed since that read, instead of overwriting the change. Omit to overwrite unconditionally.

actions.name: set_split_dns
actions.description: Replace the entire tailnet split DNS configuration.

actions.name: suspend_user
actions.description: Suspend a Tailscale user and their access to the tailnet.

userId.description: The Tailscale user ID to suspend.

actions.name: test_webhook
actions.description: Send a test event to a Tailscale webhook endpoint.

endpointId.description: The webhook endpoint ID to test.

actions.name: update_contact
actions.description: Change the account, support, or security contact email for the tailnet.

actions.name: update_key
actions.description: Replace the mutable configuration of an OAuth or federated Tailscale trust credential.

key.description: The replacement key description, scopes, tags, and identity configuration.

actions.name: update_oauth_app
actions.description: Replace the configuration of a Tailscale OAuth application.

actions.name: update_posture_integration
actions.description: Update a device posture integration and optionally replace its client secret.

integration.description: The posture integration fields to update.

actions.name: update_service
actions.description: Create or replace a named Tailscale Service definition.

service.description: The Service addresses, ports, tags, and comment.

actions.name: update_service_device_approval
actions.description: Approve or revoke approval for a Service on a device.

deviceId.description: The preferred nodeId or legacy id of the device.

approved.description: Whether the Service should be approved on the device.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale update Service device approval input.

actions.name: update_split_dns
actions.description: Merge domain-to-resolver entries into the tailnet split DNS configuration.

splitDns.description: Domain names mapped to resolver address lists.

actions.name: update_tailnet_settings
actions.description: Update reversible feature, logging, networking, or policy-link settings for the tailnet.

settings.description: The tailnet settings fields to update.

actions.name: update_user_role
actions.description: Change a Tailscale user's administrative role.

actions.name: update_webhook
actions.description: Replace the subscribed events for a Tailscale webhook endpoint.

actions.name: validate_aws_external_id
actions.description: Validate an AWS IAM role trust policy against a Tailscale external ID.

roleArn.description: The AWS IAM role ARN to validate.

inputSchema.description: Tailscale validate AWS external ID input.

anyOf.description: Tailscale AWS trust policy validation response.

outputSchema.description: Tailscale AWS trust policy validation response.

actions.name: validate_policy_file
actions.description: Validate a proposed policy file or run ACL tests without changing the tailnet policy.

validation.description: A JSON policy document, its JSON string representation, or an array of ACL tests.

outputSchema.description: Policy parsing errors, warnings, or ACL test results.
